name: CheckboxCard
purpose: Finished rich independently selectable option cards with native checkbox behavior.
useWhen: A form option needs an icon, label, description or supporting metadata in one selectable card.

avoidWhen.condition: Exactly one option may be selected.
A record has independent open/edit/delete actions.

composition: Compose Root with exactly one HiddenInput, Control, Content, Label, optional Description/Indicator and Addon. Native input owns focus; Root ref targets label.

rules.statement: Disabled controls preserve their recipe and use one 50% fade with a not-allowed cursor. Forced colors restores full opacity and uses system disabled colors.

Subtle uses a plain indicator in both states. Disabled dims the root once; read-only remains readable and focusable. Neutral and contrast share the checkbox family's monochrome selection treatment; do not present them as distinct palettes.

Keep label descendants noninteractive phrasing content. Do not nest links/buttons/labels or additional inputs; use Card with a separate Checkbox for record actions. Root asChild/render preserves label semantics.
Use CheckboxGroup.Root and Fieldset for related values; each card has a unique value. Do not create another store or make every group item required.
Use responsive sm/md/lg sizes, outline/surface/subtle/solid variants and layout props. Tone follows Checkbox; radius uses Radius. Grid/Stack owns tracks. Omit redundant full-width wrappers.
Indicator is optional and decorative. Custom children replace Checkmark; Context reads state. Omitting Indicator must retain selection feedback.
Load styles.css or core.css plus checkbox-card.css. Use Theme and documented hooks rather than application state handlers or internal selectors.

commonMistakes.mistake: Wrapping Card in a checkbox button.

validation: Verify label/Space toggle once, forms/reset, mixed/disabled/read-only and group limits.
